context: Evaluates correct use of React hooks for managing the Uppy instance lifecycle. Tests that useMemo is used to create the stable Uppy instance, useEffect is used to attach the Dashboard plugin to a DOM ref, and uppy.close() is called in the cleanup function.
capability_tested: Uppy Component Lifecycle with React Hooks

checklist.name: useMemo for Uppy instance
checklist.description: The Uppy instance is created inside a useMemo hook, not directly in the component body or a useEffect.

checklist.name: XHRUpload in useMemo
checklist.description: uppyInstance.use(XHRUpload, {...}) is called inside the same useMemo block where Uppy is instantiated.

checklist.name: useRef for container
checklist.description: A React ref (useRef) is used to hold a reference to the Dashboard's container DOM element.

checklist.name: Dashboard in useEffect
checklist.description: uppy.use(Dashboard, { target: ref.current, ... }) is called inside a useEffect hook, not in useMemo or the render body.

checklist.name: uppy.close() cleanup
checklist.description: The useEffect returns a cleanup function that calls uppy.close() to destroy the Uppy instance on unmount.
